clips.title: The story
paras: In the Dry Hills, Harpy Lieutenant Rings mark the Witchwing Slayers who command the flock. Darsok Swiftdagger at the Crossroads asks for them as proof of death.

Witchwing Slayers direct attacks on Horde travelers in the Barrens. Their rings mark their place among the flock’s leaders, above the ordinary raiders who fight with little coordination. At the Crossroads, Darsok Swiftdagger and the defenders need the rings taken from fallen slayers to confirm that this part of the harpies’ leadership has been broken.
